notes:
- Enemy markers: the red arrow over an enemy's head now only shows once someone on your team spots them. Keep your crosshair on an enemy for a moment (quicker when aiming) to spot them for your squad for 7 seconds ("ENEMY SPOTTED"). Firing, UAV sweeps and the minimap no longer put arrows over heads. In Free-for-All you only see the enemies you spotted yourself.
- First-person hands: your support hand now grips the handguard on every gun, with fingers wrapped round it. Snipers included. The arms move with the gun (recoil, sway, reloads, aiming) so the hands never slide off.
- Checked every gun from the hip and down the sights for hand and model glitches.
